errors.AI_KEY_INVALID: Claude Code is not signed in (or the token was rejected). Run claude auth login or create another token with claude setup-token.
errors.AI_KEY_UNVERIFIED: The token could not be tested right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.AI_KEY_MISSING: Claude Code is not set up. Go to Settings → AI.
errors.AI_NO_CREDIT: Your Claude subscription does not allow continuing right now.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: Your Claude subscription hit its limit. It works again when the limit resets (see claude.ai → Settings → Usage).
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Claude Code is not responding (or is not installed). Try again in a moment.
errors.AI_REQUEST_REFUSED: Claude refused the request. Check in Settings → AI → Models that the chosen model exists.

guide.title: How to create the token in Proxmox
guide.step1: Open the Proxmox panel in your browser (https://Proxmox-IP:8006).
guide.step2: Go to Datacenter → Permissions → API Tokens and click Add.
guide.step3: User: root@pam · Token ID: myhomelab · turn off "Privilege Separation".
guide.step4: Click Add and copy the Secret that appears — Proxmox only shows it once.
guide.step5: Below, the Token ID is root@pam!myhomelab and the secret is that Secret.
guide.readOnly: Prefer a read-only token? Keep "Privilege Separation" on and, under Datacenter → Permissions → Add → API Token Permission, give it the PVEAuditor role on path / with "Propagate".

modal.hostHint: The IP you open the Proxmox panel with — not the MyHomeLab container.
modal.secretHint: Proxmox only shows it when you create the token. It is stored encrypted and only your Jarvis uses it.
